My team

Fixture difficulty

Every club's next fixtures. Pick a mode to change what each fixture pill shows and how it's coloured - using your custom weights from the Rankings tab.

From to

Click the Avg FDR / Avg GF / Avg GA column headers to sort by them directly. The current gameweek's column is highlighted. Avg GF/GA come from the same Weibull-count + copula expected-goals model used across the app; the standalone scoreline predictor UI has been removed for a revamp. Green bars below a club's row mark every run of 2+ favourable fixtures in a row (not just the single best one) - drag the good-run sensitivity slider above to loosen/tighten what counts as "favourable".

Fixture swing - prime wildcard / free-hit windows

Scans the whole rest of the season for gameweeks where several teams' fixtures swing from hard to easy at the same time - that clustering is the real signal for when to wildcard or free-hit, since it means a big chunk of the player pool opens up together rather than just one team having a good run.

Chip advisor - situational plan, plus Bench Boost / Triple Captain timing

The 🧠 Chip suggestion cards look at the bigger picture - whether a cluster of genuinely strong teams have a fixture swing worth Wildcarding into (and whether that sets up a Bench Boost or Triple Captain follow-up), or whether a single isolated bad gameweek for your squad is better solved with a Free Hit than a full rebuild. Below that, candidate gameweeks for the two single-gameweek chips on their own: Bench Boost wants every squad player (especially the bench) to have a fixture, ideally with a double gameweek somewhere in the 15; Triple Captain wants your single best captaincy option (reusing the same scoring now built into the Projections tab's Captaincy column) to have an exceptional fixture. If you've loaded a squad on the My team tab it's used directly - otherwise this falls back to a pool-wide signal. This season's double chips (a second Wildcard/Free Hit/Bench Boost/Triple Captain from GW19) are accounted for throughout. Heuristic ranking, not a guarantee - treat it as a shortlist to sanity-check yourself, not an auto-pick.

Best fixture pairings

Pairs of clubs whose fixtures rotate well together over the same From/To range above - each gameweek, whichever of the two has the easier fixture is the one you'd use, so a pairing scores well even if neither club is easy every single week on its own. Change the mode pill near the top of the page (FDR / pGoals / Win% / Clean sheet % / etc.) to filter this table for a specific kind of return.

Fixture run finder

Finds each club's best run of favourable fixtures in the range above, across three tiers. A run doesn't need every single game to be easy - it just needs the average FDR across the run to stay under the tier's threshold, so one tougher game can be absorbed if the rest of the run is easy enough. Edit each tier's minimum run length and max average FDR below.

Insights

Price-change signals, squad news, and projection accuracy tracking - all built from real FPL API fields already loaded elsewhere in the app. Heuristic panels are clearly labelled as such. Each panel is a short, curated list (not a full player-pool dump) surfacing what's actually decision-relevant for that panel's question - use the filters within a panel to dig further.

📈 Player plots

Scatter plots of real per-player stats - each dot is a player, positioned by two stats at once so patterns (over/under-performers, best value, etc) jump out visually instead of needing a sorted table. Filtered to established players (450+ minutes) so it loads fast and isn't cluttered by squad players with almost no data.

💰 Price watch - likely risers & fallers

Top 12 strongest signals. Heuristic estimate, not a guarantee - there's no official/reliable external price-prediction feed, so this uses a well-known proxy real FPL price-tracking sites rely on: net transfer momentum THIS gameweek relative to the player's own ownership base (see priceChangeSignal() in code for the exact formula/thresholds). It can miss FPL's actual overnight price-change algorithm, which factors in more than is exposed via the public API.

🩹 Squad news - injuries, doubts, suspensions

Every player who isn't 100% fully fit, straight from the FPL API's own status/news/chance_of_playing fields - real live data, not an estimate. Defaults to your own squad + shortlist only (league-wide runs to 40-60+ players at once). Shortlisted players are pinned to the top, then sorted by chance of playing (lowest/most concerning first).

🎯 Projection accuracy tracker

Snapshots the whole player pool's pre-deadline projected points each gameweek (stored locally in your browser), then once that gameweek finishes, compares them against real points scored. Known limitation: this app doesn't have historical snapshots of what it would have projected in past gameweeks before today, so tracking is forward-looking only - it starts building a record from whichever gameweek is current when you first open this panel, and grows a longer track record the more gameweeks you play through with the app open.

How this is calculated

The real formulas and weights behind every projection, matchup, captaincy and goals number in the app - read straight from the live code, not a marketing simplification. Nothing here is hidden; if a number surprises you, this is where to check why.

Head-to-head

Pick two clubs. There's no real data source for manager philosophies or planned lineups anywhere - not FPL's API, not anywhere public - so that side is a notepad you fill in yourself and it's saved for next time. Everything else on this page (fixtures, player form, stats) is real, live FPL data for the two clubs you pick.

Quick calibration questionnaire - next gameweek

A faster way to tune club strength than dragging every slider on the Rankings tab - answer "does X have a better attack/defence than Y" questions about clubs actually facing off in the next gameweek, and each answer nudges those two clubs' Attack/Defence override up or down slightly. Keep going as long as you like; every answer compounds on the last, so your gut feel converges toward a full set of ratings over time. Skip any question you're unsure about.

Rankings

Two separate, independent systems live on this page - they don't affect each other. Fixture difficulty (below) colours individual fixtures. Club rankings (further down) is a single best-to-worst list of all 20 clubs.

Data mode - Legacy vs Live

Controls how much every prediction model on the site (Projections, Captaincy scoring, and the Club rankings below) leans on last season's real full-season data vs this season's own numbers so far. Live (default) weighs last season up to 80% / this season up to 20% - a full proven year outweighs this season's own early sample by design, but that 80% ceiling is now itself adjustable (down to 0% - fully live, ignoring last season entirely) via the slider. That this-season share is itself a ceiling, only reached once a player actually has a real (270+ minute, roughly 3-game) sample; below that, this season counts for even less and last season fills the rest, so a couple of games can't move a projection much either way. Legacy pushes further still toward last season - adjustable from 80% up to 100% (this season ignored entirely at the top end) - for treating this season's numbers as close to irrelevant even once it's underway.

Player form comparison

Two same-position players, real underlying stats shown side by side (FM-attribute style). Pick who looks sharper based on what you've actually seen and it nudges their projection - same opt-in, capped-effect pattern as the player questions above.

1. Fixture difficulty formula

Controls the colour-coded FDR pills shown next to fixtures everywhere on the site (this tab's fixture list, Player stats detail panel, squad builder, the FDR tab). Each slider is how much one trait of your opponent counts against you when judging how hard a fixture is - higher = that trait matters more.

Saved setting slots

Save the current FDR weights, club ranking weights, and prediction-model weights together as a named slot, so you can switch between setups without re-entering every value. Club overrides and fixture-run tiers aren't included - those persist on their own regardless of which slot is active.

Export my settings

Downloads everything Touchline has saved in this browser - player attribute edits, prior-league projections, club overrides, main positions, shortlist, and all the formula weights above - as one JSON file. Use this to back up your setup, move it to another browser, or send it to whoever maintains the site to set as the default a first-time visitor sees.

2. Club rankings

A single ranked list of all 20 clubs (below), best to worst - separate from the fixture-difficulty formula above and not used by it. Each slider is how much one signal counts toward a club's overall rank.

Edit formula

⚽ Likely lineups - make matchups accurate to who's actually playing

By default, every matchup calculation (the Projections/Captaincy "matchup" boost, the Tactical board's auto-generated pairings) treats a club's WHOLE SQUAD as equally likely to face your player - a fringe substitute counts the same as their first-choice starter. Set a club's likely lineup below (per formation slot, e.g. "who's the right-back," "who's the striker") and every matchup involving that club switches to using those specific starters instead, for every one of their upcoming fixtures - genuinely accurate to who's likely to actually be on the pitch, not the full 25-man squad.

Each team's picker is inside its "⚽ Likely lineup" expander below, alongside its Attack/Defence/Overall sliders. Unset teams keep the previous whole-squad behaviour - nothing changes until you fill in at least one slot for that club.

Edit club strength

Disagree with FPL's rating for a club? Set Attack, Defence and Overall individually - 1 (weakest) to 5 (strongest). These feed both the FDR formula above (opponent pills, club rankings) and the predicted scoreline on the FDR fixture modal - change a club's Attack here and their predicted scorelines update to match. Starts at FPL's own computed rating for each field; hit ↺ Reset to go back to all three. Each row also has an ⚽ Likely lineup expander (see the card above) for setting that club's specific starters, used by matchup calculations club-wide.
